characters.name: SCISSORMAN
characters.who: Speaks only in anagrams: every word is a real word, and each line uses exactly the letters of a hidden line. Decoded: talk = LISTEN. SNIP SPARE THREAD. / before battle = SWORD ARMED. REALITY ENDS. / you beat him = NOTHING LEFT. (felt: the cloth Scissormen leave behind) / he beats you = SNIP. YOU ARE SPARE. / after you win = YOU REMAIN. STRANGE. / after he wins = RETURN NOW, SHAPE.
characters.chat:
SCISSORMAN:
SILENT. SPIN PEARS HATRED.
characters.intro:
SCISSORMAN:
WORDS DREAM. IRATELY DENS.
characters.afterWin:
SCISSORMAN:
YOU MARINE. GARNETS.

characters.name: NESSA
characters.who: Galar's Water-type gym leader from HULBURY, also a model: confident, sporty, wave imagery.
characters.chat:
NESSA: The water
looks calm. Not for long!
characters.intro:
NESSA: I came
all the way from GALAR. Let's
make a splash!
characters.win:
Swept away... You rode that
wave well!
characters.afterWin:
NESSA: You'd do
great in GALAR.
characters.afterLoss:
NESSA: Keep your
head above water!

characters.name: MR NOBODY
characters.who: Doom Patrol's Mr Nobody: Brotherhood of Dada leader, gleeful absurdist who loves pointless, surreal mischief.
characters.chat:
MR NOBODY:
Welcome to nowhere in
particular!
characters.intro:
MR NOBODY: Let's
battle in no direction
at all!
characters.afterWin:
MR NOBODY: Who
won? Nobody!

characters.name: ROBOTMAN
characters.who: Doom Patrol's Robotman, Cliff Steele: ex-racecar driver whose brain lives in a metal body; gruff, blunt, soft underneath.
characters.chat:
ROBOTMAN: Yeah,
I'm all metal. Get over it.
characters.intro:
ROBOTMAN: Let's
get this over with, kid.
characters.afterWin:
ROBOTMAN: Nice
hustle. Don't let it go to
your head.
characters.afterLoss:
ROBOTMAN: Shake
it off. I did.

characters.name: RIKA
characters.who: Paldea Elite Four, Ground type: laid-back, sharp, runs her battle like an interview.
characters.chat:
RIKA: Mind if I
ask a few questions?
characters.intro:
RIKA: Let's see
what you're made of. Dig in!
characters.win:
Ha! You buried
me. Nice work.
characters.afterWin:
RIKA: Interview
over. You pass.

characters.name: LOVRINA
characters.who: XD's Lovrina, Cipher scientist who designed Shadow Lugia: perky, flirty, vain.
characters.chat:
LOVRINA: Ooh,
you're cute! Shame about
your team.
characters.intro:
LOVRINA: Let's
see if you're as good as you look!
characters.afterWin:
LOVRINA: Don't
let it go to your head, OK?

characters.name: RUI
characters.who: Colosseum's Rui from ORRE: kind and brave, can see the hearts of Shadow Pokemon.
characters.chat:
RUI: I can see
your POKEMON's hearts. They
look happy!
characters.intro:
RUI: I came all
the way from ORRE. Let's go!
characters.win:
You and your
team are close. I can tell.
characters.loss:
Don't worry.
Your hearts are still
strong!
characters.afterWin:
RUI: That was
fun! Thank you!
characters.afterLoss:
RUI: Rest up.
You'll get it!

characters.name: CHOBIN
characters.who: XD's Chobin of GATEON PORT: self-declared genius inventor who talks about himself in the third person and shouts his own name.
characters.chat:
CHOBIN: CHOBIN
is a genius! CHOBIN!
characters.intro:
CHOBIN: Behold
CHOBIN's brain!
characters.afterWin:
CHOBIN: CHOBIN
will invent a better plan!

characters.name: MIROR B
characters.who: Cipher admin Miror B. from Colosseum/XD: disco afro, Ludicolo, everything is about dancing and the groove.
characters.chat:
MIROR B: Do you
feel the rhythm?
characters.intro:
MIROR B: Let's
dance! Ha ha!
characters.loss:
Ha ha! Dance
on home, baby!
characters.afterWin:
MIROR B: You've
got moves. I'll admit it.

characters.name: ARTIST
characters.who: Painter. Team: drawing, mimicry, living sculpture (Smeargle, Mr. Mime, Sudowoodo).
characters.chat:
ARTIST: Hold that
pose! Perfect. You'd make a
lovely sketch.
characters.intro:
ARTIST: Let's
paint this battle in
bold colors!
characters.win:
A masterpiece... and you painted
it, not me.
characters.afterWin:
ARTIST: I'll
sketch that battle from
memory.
characters.afterLoss:
ARTIST: Every
artist starts with a mess.

characters.name: BOARDER
characters.who: Snowboarder. Team: snow and ice (Dewgong, Piloswine, Cloyster, Lapras).
characters.chat:
BOARDER: Brr!
JOHTO's warm. I miss the
slopes.
characters.intro:
BOARDER: Let's
carve some powder!
characters.afterWin:
BOARDER: You've
got serious balance.

characters.name: BUCK
characters.who: Sinnoh's Buck: cocky, energetic, says 'Heh!'. Team: walls that won't budge (Umbreon, Shuckle, Magcargo).
characters.chat:
BUCK: Heh! You
look tough. But can you
crack a wall?
characters.intro:
BUCK: Heh! My
team doesn't budge. Try it!
characters.afterWin:
BUCK: Heh! You're
the real deal.

characters.name: CHERYL
characters.who: Sinnoh's Cheryl: gentle, motherly healer. Team: Chansey/Blissey and high HP.
characters.chat:
CHERYL: Oh! A
kind face. Battles heal
hearts too.
characters.intro:
CHERYL: Let's
battle gently, okay?
characters.win:
Oh my... You
won. How lovely.
characters.afterWin:
CHERYL: Rest
well, and keep smiling.
characters.afterLoss:
CHERYL: Don't
worry. Heal up, then try again.

characters.name: CYNTHIA
characters.who: Sinnoh Champion: calm, gracious, studies myths. Team: Gen 2 stand-ins for her champion team.
characters.chat:
CYNTHIA: Old
myths say POKEMON once
were people.
characters.intro:
CYNTHIA: Show
me everything you have.
characters.win:
Splendid. I
am glad we met.
characters.loss:
A fine effort. You'll grow
stronger.
characters.afterWin:
CYNTHIA: You
have a gift. Keep at it.
characters.afterLoss:
CYNTHIA: Study
your losses. They teach the
most.

characters.name: ENGINEER
characters.who: Engineer. Team: industrial Electric/Steel with Porygon research.
characters.chat:
ENGINEER: Mind
the wiring! I'm testing a
new circuit.
characters.intro:
ENGINEER: Power
is at full! Engage!
characters.win:
Short circuit!
Back to the lab.
characters.afterWin:
ENGINEER: I'll
recalibrate.

characters.name: IVY
characters.who: Professor Ivy of VALENCIA ISLAND: field researcher. Team: island ecology.
characters.chat:
IVY: VALENCIA's
POKEMON are so curious.
Like yours!
characters.intro:
IVY: Let me
study your team up close!
characters.afterWin:
IVY: Your team
is in fine health.

characters.name: MARLEY
characters.who: Sinnoh's Marley: quiet, blunt, few words. Team: speed (Arcanine, Crobat, Jolteon).
characters.chat: MARLEY: ... You're slow.
characters.intro:
MARLEY: ...
Keep up.
characters.afterWin:
MARLEY: ...
Not bad.

characters.name: MARY
characters.who: DJ Mary of the GOLDENROD RADIO TOWER. Team: radio and music (Meowth, Wigglytuff, Ampharos).
characters.chat:
MARY: This is
DJ MARY, live from the
CONFERENCE!
characters.intro:
MARY: Let's put
this battle on the air!
characters.afterWin:
MARY: Tune in
for your next big win!

characters.name: MAYLENE
characters.who: VEILSTONE's Fighting gym leader: earnest, trains barefoot. Team: fighting.
characters.chat:
MAYLENE: I train
barefoot. It keeps me
humble.
characters.intro:
MAYLENE: I'll
give it everything!
characters.win:
I lost... I need
to train more.
characters.loss:
Your spirit is
strong. Mine was stronger.
characters.afterWin:
MAYLENE: Thank
you. I learned a lot.

characters.name: MIRA
characters.who: Sinnoh's Mira: young psychic girl who talks about herself in the third person and gets lost. Team: special attackers (Alakazam, Gengar).
characters.chat:
MIRA: MIRA got
lost again... Is this the
right room?
characters.intro:
MIRA: MIRA will
be brave!
characters.loss:
MIRA did it!
MIRA did it!
characters.afterWin:
MIRA: MIRA will
get stronger!
characters.afterLoss:
MIRA: Don't be
sad. MIRA was lucky!

characters.name: RILEY
characters.who: IRON ISLAND's Riley: stoic aura reader. Team: physical attackers (Ursaring, Heracross, Machamp).
characters.chat:
RILEY: Your aura
is steady.
characters.intro:
RILEY: Let our
auras clash.
characters.win:
Your aura burns
bright. Well done.
characters.afterWin:
RILEY: Trust
that aura.

characters.name: STEVEN
characters.who: Hoenn Champion and rare-stone collector. Team: steel, stone, ancient (Skarmory, Steelix, Aerodactyl).
characters.chat:
STEVEN: I came
to JOHTO for rare stones.
Found you.
characters.intro:
STEVEN: Let's
see how hard you really are.
characters.win:
Ah... You shine
like a gem.
characters.afterWin:
STEVEN: A rare
find, you are.

characters.name: TAMER
characters.who: Animal tamer. Team: tough handled beasts (Arbok, Tauros, Persian).
characters.chat:
TAMER: Easy...
My team bites.
characters.intro:
TAMER: Heel!
Now, attack!
characters.afterWin:
TAMER: You
handle POKEMON well.

characters.name: VETERAN M
characters.who: Veteran trainer: experienced generalist. Team: Nidoking, Lapras, Snorlax, Arcanine. Lines say VETERAN: rather than VETERAN M: -- change if you prefer.
characters.chat:
VETERAN: I've
battled for forty years.
characters.intro:
VETERAN: Show
this old-timer something new.
characters.afterWin:
VETERAN: Don't
ever stop learning.

characters.name: WALKER
characters.who: Walker, bird specialist. Team: Pidgeot, Noctowl, Xatu, Skarmory.
characters.chat:
WALKER: Listen!
Hear the birds?
characters.intro:
WALKER: My birds
own the sky!
characters.afterWin:
WALKER: You'd
make a fine bird keeper.

characters.name: CAPTAIN
characters.who: Ship's captain. Team: seafaring water (Golduck, Tentacruel, Mantine).
characters.chat:
CAPTAIN: Ahoy!
Smooth seas today.
characters.intro:
CAPTAIN: All
hands on deck!
characters.afterWin:
CAPTAIN: You've
got sea legs.

characters.name: EXTERMINATOR
characters.who: Pest-control worker. Team: poison and pests (Raticate, Ariados, Weezing).
characters.chat:
EXTERMINATOR:
Seen any bugs? I'm on the job.
characters.intro:
EXTERMINATOR:
Time to spray!
characters.afterWin:
EXTERMINATOR:
You're one tough bug.

characters.name: SLOT MANIAC
characters.who: Game-corner regular. Team: chance and tricks (Ditto, Wobbuffet, Porygon2).
characters.chat:
SLOT MANIAC:
Three in a row! I can feel it!
characters.intro:
SLOT MANIAC:
Roll the reels!
characters.afterWin:
SLOT MANIAC:
Lady Luck likes you.
